models.label: Brackish underwater (YOLOv8n, fast)
models.license: See model card; trained on Brackish Underwater (Denmark)
models.note: Classes: crab, fish, jellyfish, shrimp, small_fish, starfish. Single-camera / brackish water — treat open-ocean detections as screening only.

models.label: NOAA MOUSS fish (YOLOv8n, grayscale)
models.license: NOAA/DOC scientific product; see model card disclaimer. Not official NOAA communication.
models.note: One class: fish. Trained on grayscale MOUSS (Pacific Islands Fisheries Science Center) imagery. The page converts the frame to grayscale before inference. Model card: may not generalise to colour reef cameras; screening only.

models.label: NOAA sea urchin (YOLO11n, fast)
models.license: NOAA/DOC scientific product; see model card disclaimer. Not official NOAA communication.
models.note: One class: urchin. Trained on Marine Detect + Roboflow urchin images (CC BY 4.0). Screening only.

models.label: Motion only (no neural net)
models.note: Background subtraction. Works offline with no model download.

candidates.label: Marine Detect Fish+Invertebrates (Indo-Pacific)
candidates.note: YOLOv8l, 15 reef classes (fish families, urchin, giant clam, sea cucumber, lobster, crown-of-thorns). Published .pt is 84 MB; ONNX export at 320 px is 167 MB (over GitHub’s 100 MB file limit) and about 20× the FLOPs of the bundled nano models. Export locally with scripts/export_vision_models.py and upload the .onnx. License: AGPL-3.0. Author confidence threshold 0.523.

candidates.label: Marine Detect MegaFauna (shark, turtle, ray)
candidates.note: YOLOv8l, 3 classes. Same size/speed constraint as FishInv. Author confidence threshold 0.546. License: AGPL-3.0.

candidates.label: FathomNet VME (coral, crinoid, sponge, fish)
candidates.note: YOLOv8x, 137 MB .pt; too large for in-browser default. Deep-sea benthic imagery, not kelp-forest cameras.

candidates.label: FathomNet / MBARI-315k YOLOv8
candidates.note: Deep-sea taxa; large; not yet bundled.

candidates.label: Hakai Kelp-RGB (aerial segmentation)
candidates.note: Giant kelp / bull kelp semantic segmentation on 2048×2048 drone stills, not a live-camera box detector. No in-browser YOLO kelp model was found with a named source.
